Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? We’ve got answers to help you get started.

1. Who can become a seller on POBlancer?

Anyone with a skill or service to offer can apply as a seller on POBlancer, including independent freelancers, rising talent, and approved POB freelancers. Seller onboarding usually works best when the platform clearly explains who can join and what standards apply to each category.

2. What freelancer categories are available on POBlancer?

POBlancer allows different freelancer paths such as Independent Freelancer, Rising Talent Freelancer, POB Internally Trained Freelancer, and POB Experienced Freelancer. These categories help users understand their position on the platform and help clients choose the level of trust, supervision, and experience they want.

3. What makes POB freelancers different?

POB freelancers are trained, reviewed, and held to stricter quality, professionalism, and conduct standards than public freelancers. Your attached agreements show that POB freelancers are subject to added obligations around confidentiality, quality control, deadlines, client handling, and use of POB systems and brand processes.

4. Can beginners join POBlancer?

Yes, beginners can join through the Rising Talent category, which allows growing freelancers to build experience and visibility on the platform. Freelance marketplaces often support newer freelancers as long as expectations, setup, and standards are made clear from the start.

5. Do I need to be trained by POB before joining?

No, not every freelancer needs to be trained by POB before joining the platform. However, anyone who wants to register under a POB-branded category must meet POB’s additional standards and may need approval, training, onboarding, or ongoing review.

6. How do I start selling my services?


Create your account, choose the correct freelancer category, complete your profile, and set up your services professionally. Seller onboarding best practices emphasize keeping the setup clear and helping sellers become ready to offer services quickly.Content

7. Are POB freelancers required to follow extra rules?

Yes, POB freelancers must follow stricter rules on conduct, confidentiality, service quality, communication, and brand representation. The attached agreements also include rules around private client dealings, POB content, deadlines, and accountability for poor workmanship or brand damage

8. Do POB freelancers need to sign an agreement?


Yes, POB Internally Trained Freelancers and POB Experienced Freelancers should select their respective category on the sign up page and download the agreement letter that matches their category. Complete it, and send it to freelancer@pob.ng. This helps formalize expectations around standards, obligations, and working relationships under the POB brand.

9. Why should I sell on POBlancer?

POBlancer gives freelancers a structured place to present services, build trust, and connect with clients looking for digital and creative solutions. Well-run freelance marketplaces improve trust by making profiles, communication, expectations, and service standards easier for both freelancers and clients to understand

10. Mode of Payment

Payment will be made via bank transfer and international payment transfer. Please note the following flat bank fees deducted for each payout, and choose your preferred method accordingly:

  • ACH / Stablecoin: $1 flat fee per payout. Recommended for US-based affiliates.

  • Domestic Wire (US): $10 flat fee per payout.

  • SWIFT (International): $16 flat fee per payout.

Note: For SWIFT payouts, the final amount received in your bank account may vary depending on your local bank’s policy regarding intermediary bank charges (SHA / BEN / OUR).
